image_descriptions.description: 古典大理石雕塑女性戴着金色耳机和蓝色太阳镜坐在长椅上吹泡泡，背景是海洋和山脉
image_descriptions.translation: A classical marble sculpture of a woman wearing gold headphones and blue sunglasses sits on a bench blowing bubbles, with ocean and mountains in the background

image_descriptions.description: 文艺复兴风格画作中的戴月桂冠黄裙女子在海边看手机，背景有天使和花卉
image_descriptions.translation: A Renaissance-style painting of a laurel-crowned woman in yellow dress checking her phone by the sea, with angels and flowers in the background

image_descriptions.description: 金毛犬叼着报纸走向穿粉裙的幼儿，室内有木质家具和自然光线
image_descriptions.translation: A golden retriever carrying a newspaper approaches a toddler in pink dress, with wooden furniture and natural light indoors

image_descriptions.description: 小人们爬上一只巨大的粉色盒子，盒子里水满溢出，周围是金黄的玉米粒
image_descriptions.translation: Tiny people climbing a giant pink box overflowing with water, surrounded by golden corn kernels

image_descriptions.description: 水下篮球比赛，裁判持口哨，海马在篮筐旁，五彩珊瑚环绕，海洋生物观赛
image_descriptions.translation: Underwater basketball game with a referee blowing whistle, seahorses near the basket, surrounded by colorful corals and observing marine life

image_descriptions.description: 酷猫在沙漠中与休息的狮子自拍，单爪持手机，表情自信
image_descriptions.translation: Cool cat taking selfie with a resting lion in desert, holding phone with one paw confidently

image_descriptions.description: 老鹰俯冲抓取户外餐桌上的披萨，背景为绿色山脉和宁静天空
image_descriptions.translation: Eagle swooping down to grab pizza from outdoor table against green mountains and calm sky
image_descriptions.style: 野生动物与人类物品互动

image_descriptions.description: 穿NASA粉色宇航服的猫在月球跳跃，可见头盔细节，背景有宇宙、脚印和登月舱
image_descriptions.translation: Cat in pink NASA spacesuit jumping on moon with detailed helmet, showing cosmic background, footprints and lunar module

image_descriptions.description: 狮子、老虎和猎豹在日落草原自拍，橙红天空树木营造温暖氛围
image_descriptions.translation: Lion, tiger and cheetah taking group selfie on sunset grassland with orange-red sky creating warm atmosphere

image_descriptions.description: 猫站冲浪板迎击巨浪，阴云天空有海鸥飞翔，画面动态色彩丰富
image_descriptions.translation: Cat standing on surfboard riding huge wave with dark cloudy sky and flying seagulls, dynamic and colorful
